observed_defect.runner: stop() set requested_ns and method=direct_child_terminate_wait before checking poll(); a child that had already completed still produced a cancellation record, and finish() classified any requested_ns as cancelled.
observed_defect.verifier: cancellation acceptance did not require an issued kill, an alive-at-request observation or a non-zero termination exit; mutating the retained onload_3 exit code to 0 still verified.
observed_defect.not_claimed: The retained record actually held exit_code 1, so the real run is not asserted to have been misclassified; only the missing evidence fields and the verifier gap are.

repair.owner_contract: DC-MP-IMG2 opt-in WIC observation boundary updated first
runner: stop_outcome(): only stop_confirmed yields cancelled or timeout; already_exited keeps the real probe outcome; unverified_race yields not_verified
output removal only after a confirmed stop
verifier: requires the closed state and boolean action fields
stop_confirmed needs alive_at_request, issued kill, no kill error, reaped non-zero exit equal to exit_after_request, identity_verified and observed_ns == exited_ns
already_exited needs no request, no kill and returncode_before_request == exit_code

cases: exit 1 before request is not a cancellation
confirmed kill requires issued terminate and non-zero exit
finish removes output only after a confirmed stop
verifier_negatives: zero exit as a confirmed stop

actual_evidence.confirmed_stops: six cancel scenarios, two pre-OnLoad repeats, one in-OnLoad attempt and the operator timeout
actual_evidence.natural_completions: five single decodes, two refusals, two OnLoad attempts that completed first and the three cohort workers
actual_evidence.oracle: independent-oracle.json rebuilt from the tracked raster archive
actual_evidence.meaning: The repaired runner separates natural completion from a confirmed stop in actual Windows runs; a never-stopped worker is no longer representable as cancelled.
